title: Weighted approximate tangent spaces transfer under the dilation η_{x,r}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ, x, y ∈ ℝ^P, r > 0 and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P. If Q is the weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at y (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y Q), then Q is the weighted approximate tangent space at r⁻¹(y − x) of the image set {r⁻¹(w − x) : w ∈ M} with multiplicity z ↦ θ(x + r z).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P)), 0 < r → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n ((fun w => r⁻¹ • (w - x)) '' M) (fun z => θ (x + r • z)) (r⁻¹ • (y - x)) Q
